label: <DEL> step of short sequences (plus weak early first-occurrences of j/z/1/f/o)
explanation: Main component (about 73% of activation mass, all of the strongest activations): the delimiter step. Fires on <DEL> in 34% of sequences, with rate and magnitude falling as L grows: about 87% precision for L<=5 and weak or absent for L>=7. Top activations are all L=2-3-token-style short sequences (L=3/4), often starting with k. Secondary weak component (about 27% of mass, low magnitude, about 0.1-0.3 of max): original-phase steps t=2..4 where a token appears for the first time, mostly j, z, 1, f, o (also t, m, x more weakly). Never fires at t=0-1, never in the copy phase, and almost never on repeated tokens. Dev: P 0.66, R 0.77, F1 0.71, mass recall 0.88.
